Iran Accuses Ukraine of Deadly Caspian Sea Vessel Attack

Iran has accused Ukraine of attacking an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea, an incident that resulted in the death of one sailor and injured another. Iran summoned Ukraine's chargé d'affaires and vowed retaliation. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy later confirmed the strike. The incident marks a new development in the ongoing conflict.
